Can you point on config of hiding trashholdes

Header hiding thresholds are configured here:

[use-scroll-hide.ts](/Users/fedorshevchenko/Projects/work/dna/web/src/widgets/Header/logic/use-scroll-hide.ts:11)

```ts
const SCROLL_HIDE_BREAKPOINTS = [
  { minWidth: 1024, topOffset: 80, hideThreshold: 4, showThreshold: 2 },
  { minWidth: 768, topOffset: 60, hideThreshold: 8, showThreshold: 6 },
  { minWidth: 0, topOffset: 40, hideThreshold: 16, showThreshold: 12 },
];
```

- `topOffset`: header never hides near the top of the page.
- `hideThreshold`: downward scroll delta required to hide it.
- `showThreshold`: upward scroll delta required to reveal it.
- `minWidth`: viewport breakpoint for that configuration.

The conditions are applied in [the scroll handler](/Users/fedorshevchenko/Projects/work/dna/web/src/widgets/Header/logic/use-scroll-hide.ts:37).
